summary: A buyer who purchased a couch from a Facebook Marketplace listing posted by the phone owner's girlfriend — the phone owner texted on her behalf. They sent an Apple Pay deposit for half to hold the couch while waiting on their apartment move-in confirmation, then coincidentally turned out to be moving into the same building (Parkline, 400 NW 1st Ave, Miami — north tower). They picked the couch up in the lobby on Friday 2026-06-19 around 4pm with a friend helping carry. No business relationship; transaction appears complete.
key_facts: Bought a couch listed on Facebook Marketplace by the phone owner's girlfriend; phone owner texted on her behalf
Paid half up front via Apple Pay as a deposit to reserve it; exact price never stated in the thread
